                       OCCIDENTAL PERMIAN LTD.’S REPLY BRIEF

       Occidental Permian, Ltd. (“OPL”) respectfully submits this post-hearing reply brief. The

Comprehensive Stipulation (“Stipulation”) was the product of extensive negotiations between SPS

and every ratepayer group that participated in this proceeding, and the record clearly demonstrates

that the Stipulation will result in “fair, just and reasonable rates.”1 The only party that opposes

any portion of the Stipulation is Commission Staff, and the arguments raised in Staff’s initial brief

have all been addressed in the initial briefs filed by OPL and the other signatories to the Stipulation.

Accordingly, OPL urges the Commission to adopt the Stipulation in its entirety.
